# metacrafter

Python CLI and library for labeling table fields and data files. Detects PII, person names, identifiers, dates, and semantic data types using YAML rules, optional LLM/RAG classification, and registry-linked metadata.

Site: https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/
CLI help: `metacrafter <command> --help`

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/installation) — extras, pip, Python 3.8–3.12
- [Quick start](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/quick-start)
- [Cookbook](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/cookbook)
- [Basic usage](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/basic-usage)
- [Shared CLI options](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/shared-options)
- [Troubleshooting](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/troubleshooting)
